title: Dhisayaasha Munaaradaha
intro: Waqti dheer ka hor, ilbaxnimo xooggan ayaa soo baxday, oo lagu kala soocay waxqabadkeeda cajiibka ah ee dhismaha iyo xoogga xooggan. Hay'addan wadajirka ah waxaa la siiyay kheyraad badan iyo karti jireed, haddana waxay doorteen waddo ka dhan ah farriinta rabbaaniga ah ee loo soo diray si ay u hagto. Sheekadoodu waxay u adeegtaa cashar qoto dheer oo ku jira taariikhda, markhaati u ah cawaaqibka ka dhalan kara diidmada runta.
clues: Waxaa naloo siiyay xoog iyo dherer aad u weyn, oo aan ka duwanayn dad kale oo waqtigeenna joogay.
Waxaa naloo yaqaannay dhisidda dhismayaasha waaweyn iyo tiirarka dhaadheer meel kasta oo sare, annagoo u maleynayna inaan weligeen noolaan doonno.
Waxaa naloo soo diray rasuul naga mid ah si uu noo digo, isagoo noogu yeeraya inaan caabudno Alle oo keliya oo aan ka tagno sanamyadeenna.
Waxaan si kibir leh u weydiinay rasuulkeennii, annagoo weydiinayna inay noo yimaadeen oo keliya inay naga dhigaan inaan caabudno Alle oo aan ka tagno waxay awowayaasheen caabudi jireen.
Dhulkeennu wuxuu ku barakoobay beero, ilo, iyo beero bacrin ah, laakiin waxaan barwaaqadayada ku sababeynay awooddeenna, ee ma ahayn Abuurahayaga.
Kaftankeenna joogtada ah iyo jeesjeeskeenna awgeed, ugu dambeyntii waxaa na baabi'iyay dabayl cabsi leh oo kulul oo maalmo iyo habeenno badan socotay.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: In la weydiisto in la allabaryo geel gaar ah
In lagu xujeeyo in la soo saaro toban suuradood sida Qur'aanka.
Iyadoo la tusayo kala qaybsanaanta badda
Nebi uga digay daadka soo socda
Diidmada nebi ka digaya dhisidda xad-dhaafka ah iyo caabudidda sanamyada
trial.answer: Diidmada nebi ka digaya dhisidda xad-dhaafka ah iyo caabudidda sanamyada

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxay isu beddeshay daanyeerro iyo doofaarro
Waxaa baabi'iyay dabayl aad u daran oo ba'an
outcome.answer: Waxaa baabi'iyay dabayl aad u daran oo ba'an

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
